name: coordinator-buffer-derived-only
body: The coordinator never defers a mutation's visibility. The coordinator performs the durable write itself, directly, one commit per logical mutation — it owns the node-file read-modify-write and the `git::commit_files` commit (coordinator-single-writer), so durable node-file writes are NOT deferred or buffered; and the exact projection delta is applied write-through as the mutation completes, so the derived DB is NOT buffered or flushed in a batch at session end either. Amortization keeps one DB open/parse across the session; it does not batch visibility. Durable writes are never buffered in memory without a WAL. Acceptance: killing the session between mutations loses no durable write and leaves no unapplied projection delta for any mutation that reported success; one logical mutation → one commit still holds.
